newsitem.title: UK: BFI down seven as Atlantic Panamaxes remain weak.
newsitem.headline: BFI down seven as Atlantic Panamaxes remain weak.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was down seven points on Monday to 1,420 points.
Brokers reported stronger demand for Capers in the Atlantic but rates for Panamaxes in this area continued to fall.
Keoyang have fixed Halla Fortune for 54,000 heavy grain USGulf to Japan April 28/May 12 $23.75 no combination, down 25 cents from last week's fixture.
Brokers said the problems for tonnage in the USGulf have put further pressure on rates from Brazil and Argentina.
Toepfer were reported to have fxied 55,000 hreavy grain Santos to Continent for April 26/May 6 at only $15.00.
Brokers reported higher rates for modern craned tonnage from the Continent for trips to the Faar East but details have been slow to emerge.
At 1300 GMT BIFFEX was between 21 and 10 points lower reflecting weakness in the underlying market and turnover totalled 99 lots.
